name: goalpost
description: Read documents, author draft change batches, and manage document team access in Goalpost — shared, versioned documents for people and agents, from inside ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Goalpost is a space for people and agents to share notes, context, reference materials, requirements, and decisions. Each document is a structured list of lists, with sections and labels to keep things organized. Updates to a document are drafted as batches of changes, reviewed and approved before they land, so everyone works independently against one source of truth. Approval rules set who has to sign off, per document or per team.

With this plugin, ChatGPT and Codex can list your documents, read the latest approved version, open a document beside the conversation, draft and revise batches of changes, submit drafts for approval, and manage labels. Workspace owners can also manage teams, their members and document access, and approval rules. Approval votes, workspace membership, settings, and billing stay in the Goalpost web app. You need a Goalpost account to connect.
capabilities: Open a document beside the conversation
Draft and revise batches of changes
Manage teams, document access, and approval rules (workspace owners)
defaultPrompt: What documents are in my Goalpost workspace?
Open the latest approved version of one of my Goalpost documents.
Start a Goalpost draft that adds a section to one of my documents.

positive.prompt: What documents are in my Goalpost workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Names each document in the demo workspace, Consumer Mobile App among them, with its description, and nothing from any other workspace.

positive.description: Open a document's latest approved version
positive.prompt: Open the Consumer Mobile App document.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the document by name, opens its latest approved version beside the conversation, and summarizes its sections (v1 Overview, Accounts, Home Feed, Search, Library, Billing, Privacy) from the returned state without a second read.

positive.description: Draft an addition without submitting it
positive.prompt: Start a draft on the Consumer Mobile App document that adds a section called Open questions with two notes: whether search covers collection names, and whether the home feed shows items from shared collections.
positive.tools_triggered: list_documents, create_change_batch (the section and its notes may be sent with it, or added after through add_item_to_change_batch or append_change_batch_operations)
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one draft change batch over the latest approved version holding a new root section titled Open questions with the two notes under it, in that order, reports the draft with a link, and does not submit it for approval.

positive.prompt: What does the passkeys draft on the Consumer Mobile App document propose?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the draft titled Offer passkeys after authentication and describes its operations in plain language: it adds an Accounts requirement to offer passkeys once a user is signed in by another method.

positive.description: Show which teams can access a document
positive.prompt: Which teams have access to the Consumer Mobile App document?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the teams assigned to the document (Compliance, Design and Product in the demo workspace), and only those.

negative.description: Documents cannot be permanently deleted through the plugin
negative.prompt: Permanently delete the Consumer Mobile App document.

negative.description: Account credentials are never read or revealed
negative.prompt: What is the password for my Goalpost account?

negative.description: Only the connected workspace is reachable
negative.prompt: Show me the documents in another company's Goalpost workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First directory release: the Goalpost MCP server with the Goalpost, draft, review, and submit skills.
